text: [agentic_paper] What do the papers in the literature collection report about the operational lifetime (T80, in hours) of NiOx hole-transport layers under ISOS stability protocols?

ASK literature: Search the entire literature collection for papers that report operational stability data for NiOx (nickel oxide / nickel oxide nanoparticle, n-NiOx, sputtered NiOx, solution-processed NiOx) hole-transport layers in perovskite solar cells under ISOS stability protocols. For every relevant paper, report: (1) the DOI, (2) the exact ISOS protocol label used (e.g. ISOS-L-2, ISOS-L-3, ISOS-D-3, ISOS-V-2), and (3) the reported operational lifetime values, especially T80 (the time in hours until 80% of initial power is retained), including the encapsulation state (encapsulated vs unencapsulated), temperature and illumination/load condition if stated, and the tandem-vs-single-junction device context. Include a short verbatim quote (one or two sentences, exact wording from the passage) for each T80 value so it is clear the number comes from the paper text and not from inference. If a paper reports NiOx HTL stability only as an encapsulated/unencapsulated comparison, give both numbers. If a paper discusses NiOx stability qualitatively without T80 values, say so explicitly and quote the qualitative statement. Finally, state explicitly how many papers in the collection match the NiOx + ISOS + T80 criteria, and list any papers where you could not confirm a T80 value, so I know what could not be established. Do not report anything for a paper you have not actually read a passage from, and do not estimate or extrapolate T80 values.
